comments.value: I second that. I want a pink menu. To match the colour scheme of all my worlds XD

I've been working on Art Gallery design - and the White Walls you normally find are really challenging with this interface. I don't now if customizing is needed, but a couple of options (dark theme / happy theme) might be nice

I feel like it would be really easy for VRChat to add a RGB wheel (maybe even RGBA for making it more opaque or transparent) to color tint the UI.  That would be a really simple and easy implementation.  Hardest part is figuring out where to fit it, but there is more space with the new UI recently.

Great request!

The UI 2.0 update has a selection of themes for you to choose from, letting you customize the appearance of VRChat's menu.

https://hello.vrchat.com/blog/main-menu-update-live
@{63691297469f06772579fe6f|full_name}: Themes has been implemented, yes. Colors? No.

@{5f2ccef524735547e298ac37|full_name}: Fair enough! 🙂 We'll look into adding custom colors in the future.

Here are some requests related to custom colors that might interest you:

https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/some-vrc-backgrounds-should-also-change-the-color-of-the-ui

https://vrchat.canny.io/admin/feedback/feature-requests/p/add-custom-mmqm-color-wheel?search=color%2520menu

details: I would like to be able to personalize or change the color of my quick menu and/or my main menu... be that from a selection of themes, color schemes or perhaps a color picker of some sort.
title: Personalize the color of your menu
